args: let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const p=String(JSON.parse(s).tool_input.path||'');if(/(^|[\\/])(bun\.lock|package-lock\.json)$/.test(p)){console.error('lockfiles are changed by the package manager, not by hand');process.exit(2)}})
hooks.description: Blocks edits to lockfiles before they happen; if the hook itself fails, the edit is blocked too.
Observes edits after they happened; it can never prevent one, and it never delays the turn.
